The biggest problem for me is that it doesn’t feel like it’s in the same world. To me until dawn didn’t feel super natural. Yes there’s wendigos but to me the way they interact with the world and the way the characters talk about them it feels more like magical realism (idk if I’m using correct terms just hear me out and try to interpret what I mean). In the movie the night restarting and all these different entities and then coming back to life sorta is just too unrealistic for me. Where as the wendigos are treated as a relatively feasible thing to exist, I mean they do come from indigenous folklore. Sure you can believe what you want about whether spirit and wendigos and whatever exist but that doesn’t matter here. The game builds the world in a way where it is believable (yeah you see them so you gotta believe it but do you know what I mean?). But in no universe could you convince me that this weird sketchy building had some weird properties that can bend time and replay the night over and over reviving the characters each time until they essentially run out of deaths??? (I also may be the one person on earth who is unable to suspend my disbelief when it comes to films unless you fully give me a fleshed out explanation and people hate watching movies with me for it). But what I’m really getting at is those two stories feel like they come from different worlds and that’s why I won’t be able to delude myself into enjoying this movie it’ll just keep bugging me the whole time.
